title: Verify your email
subtitle: We sent a 6-digit code and a magic link to {{email}}.
why: Verification is required before you can use the workspace. Everything HirePilotX does sends mail as you — client submissions, candidate invites, weekly reports — so we confirm the address first. It takes one click.

errors.required: Enter the 6-digit code we sent you

errors.invalid: That code is not right. Check the digits and try again.
errors.expired: That code has expired. Send yourself a new one.
errors.too-many-attempts: Too many attempts. Request a new code to continue.
errors.cooldown: Hang on a moment before requesting another code.
errors.hourly-cap: Too many codes requested this hour. Try again later.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.subtitle: Verification links last 30 minutes. Send a fresh one to {{email}} and it'll arrive in a few seconds.
expired.note: Your workspace and any invites you already sent are untouched — only this link stopped working.

done.title: Email verified
done.subtitle: You're in. Your workspace is ready — start by adding your first client.
